_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N352073 (2025-08-22, dev split; picked: China-held): CBP held China. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. Hand edit: heat treating is the machined-and-heat-treated group, not the housings group, so the Chinese table and webs can move. Target Philippines; plant capabilities for Philippines are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: “bare steel” brake shoes (Part Numbers 4707Q, 5415Q, and 4709E2)
product.description: Bare steel brake shoes measuring 16 and ½" in length by 7" in height, used in heavy duty trucks and lacking the friction material typically attached with rivets. Each brake shoe consists of a table and two pieces of webs that are welded together, heat treated, and painted.

operations.name: welding the table and webs together
